cause: The K80 KGSL direct first boot initializes CX security, observes CM3 init, loads PDC/RSC, and starts HFI. The candidate previously required PDC/RSC before CX security.
fix: Use the existing guarded PDC/RSC programmer with the actual retained board flags after CM3 initialization and before HFI control. Report the actual PDC return. Refuse subsequent startup on CM3/PDC/HFI failure while retaining the original resources.
risk: K80 has yet to exercise this order. PDC/RSC access after CM3 depends on the actual guarded register windows and on the existing clock, SMMU and SCM conditions. No successful host case qualifies a device operation.
initial_link_preflight_correction: Fixed the build-only exact-input Counter comparison to count keys. Reused the already verified rebuilt objects.
